summary: Explicit namespace publication and read certificates connect Installer operators to the existing view event registry

replay.detail: No automatic scan, startup/read rebuild, source replay or read migration. Existing explicit bounded Installer jobs remain owner-initiated.

schema.detail: Explicit namespace registration creates one local binding table; ordinary views create no bridge schema. No shared layout/rules version change.

rules.detail: Source admission, authority, canonical order and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Namespace-aware views opt into a separate fingerprint and require matching Installer operator/source definitions. Ordinary view fingerprints and default callbacks remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No production activation, deployment or restart is included.

manual.detail: Library adopters register a binding, explicitly complete a namespace job and synchronize live semantic keys with independent source and graph certificates.

recovery.detail: A later fence cannot be cleared by an older root or live synchronization. A fresh completed namespace may recover compatible state; incompatible identities require separately reviewed lifecycle handling.
